newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan party to invest 10 mln stg in British fund.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan party to invest 10 mln stg in British fund.

text.p: Taiwan's ruling Nationalist Party said on Tuesday it has approved a plan by one of its holding companies, Central Investment Trust, to invest 10 million stg in a mutual fund of British investment bank Charterhouse.
The 10 million sterling, or approximately T$450 million, would give Central Investment a 1.67 percent ownership of the 600 million sterling fund, the Nationalist Party said in a statement.

The party also gave approval for another of its holding companies, Kuang Hwa Investment Corp, to use T$150.5 million to buy 3.5 million shares of President Securities, a subsidiary of Taiwan food giant President Enterprises.
The Nationalist Party, with total assets of T$37.8 billion, is one of the world's richest political parties. It has seven holding companies and investments in 121 firms.
